[center][b][size=6][color=#cccccc][font=Comic Sans MS]About[/font][/color][/size][/b][/center]

[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]In vanilla Stardew Valley you can only pick one profession per tier. This mod makes [/size][size=4]every[/size][size=4] profession of a tier active at the same time: reach level 5 → both level-5 professions work; reach level 10 → all four work. SpaceCore custom skills (Travelling, Cooking, etc.) are detected automatically.[/size][/font]

[font=Arial Black][size=4]原版星露谷每个等级职业只能二选一。本Mod让达到后该等级全部职业同时生效：5级→两个5级职业都生效；10级→四个都生效。支持SpaceCore自定义等级技能（旅行、烹饪等），自动识别。[/size][/font]
[line]

[center][b][color=#e06666][size=6][font=Comic Sans MS]【Notes】[/font][/size][/color]
[/b][/center]
[center][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][b]About "the last skill cannot be reset"[/b]　 [b]← [/b][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355]Walk Of Life   技能大修[/url] [/b][/size][/font][/center]

[list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]Reported: when four skills are all maxed and the last skill keeps gaining XP until Mastery also levels up, that last skill can no longer be reset.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]This is an [b]interaction between Walk Of Life and the vanilla 1.6 Mastery system - not an All Professions issue[/b]. This mod never touches the Statue of Transcendence (skill reset) or the Mastery system. The root cause lies on the Walk Of Life side (likely related to a "no reset without Mastery requirement" guard it removed; needs the author's confirmation).[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]This mod handles it as-is and makes no changes.[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]Player advice:[/size][/font]
[list=1]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]If you want to keep resetting after max level, do the reset [b]before[/b] that last skill's Mastery is fully leveled;[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=4]If it already happened, feel free to keep playing - no action needed;[/size][/font][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]Other needs? Leave a comment and I'll evaluate.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][left][/left]

[center][font=Arial Black][size=4][b]关于"最后一项技能无法重置"的说明[/b]　 [b]← [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355]Walk Of Life   技能大修[/url] [/b][/size][/font][/center]

[list]
[*][font=Arial Black][size=4][size=4]近期有玩家反馈：在四项技能全部满级的情况下，若最后一个技能继续升级、直至"精通"也升级，该技能将无法重置。[/size][/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial Black][size=4][size=4]说明：该现象是 [b]Walk Of Life 与星露谷 1.6 精通系统之间的交互行为，并非本模组（All Professions）的问题[/b]——本模组从不干预超越雕像（技能重置）与精通系统。具体根因在技能大修侧（疑似与其移除的"未满足精通条件时禁止重置"保护机制有关，需作者确认）。[/size][/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial Black][size=4][size=4]对本模组而言，此行为按现有设计处理、暂不做改动。[/size][/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Arial Black][size=4]给玩家的建议：[/size][/font]
[list=1]
[*][font=Arial Black][size=4]若希望在满级后仍能重置加点，请在"最后一项技能精通未练满"之前完成重置；[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial Black][size=4]若已出现该情况，可放心继续游戏，无需处理；[/size][/font][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Arial Black]如确有其他需求，欢迎留言反馈，我会评估是否调整。[/font][/size][/*]

新增 Skill Overhaul 兼容（30 个 15/20 级职业可强制生效，GMCM 新页）；修复等级误判；按等级模式忽略手动记录，未达标职业必然不生效。

Manifest.Name: All Professions
Manifest.Description: Keep every skill profession active at once - vanilla + SpaceCore custom skills. Auto-detects Walk Of Life (coexists safely) and Vanilla Plus Professions (VPP Lv15/20 professions by level). / 全职业技能同时生效，支持原版与 SpaceCore 自定义技能，与技能大修（Walk Of Life）、VPP 职业扩展兼容。
Manifest.Author: YTDB233
